answer: Topological Path Diversity Enforcement. Nodes must periodically forge valid communication loops through at least four disjoint neighborhood clusters to broadcast their transaction pulse. Every valid route requires distinct intermediate relay nodes that share no common parent subnets. An attacker adding sybil nodes incurs a severe routing penalty. Because synthetic cluster members naturally collapse into tightly coupled local cliques, they cannot establish the mandatory long-range bridge connections.
